papers.title: Order for rock
lines: Please send two gross of rock, 'A Present From Blackpool', to the seafront stall by Friday.
Spell it right this time. Last year's batch said 'A Prezent From Black Pool' and caused a stir.

papers.title: Dance card
lines: First dance: the Gay Gordons. Partner: a young man with ears.
Second dance: also him. Third dance: he trod on my foot. Fourth dance: I said yes.

papers.title: Illuminations memo
lines: Lights on at dusk, first Friday of the season. Switch to be thrown by someone famous or someone's mother.
Bulbs are to be counted, not stolen. This means you, Terry.

trail.clue: A spare bulb box was put out of sight near the lamp post. 'Mind the cable.'

papers.title: Donkey rota
lines: Monday: Neddy and Mavis. Tuesday: Neddy and Mavis. Wednesday: Mavis, because Neddy has a headache.
Please do not ask what a donkey headache looks like. You will know.
